title: Hospital segmented clinical network
goal: Show hospital network segmentation for clinical, biomedical, administration, and guests.

rubric.must: The drawing visibly includes Healthcare NGFW at the network edge or core.
The picture visibly distinguishes clinical, biomedical, administrative, and guest segments.
core and access switching paths are visibly labelled as separate logical segments.
Visible links show readable media, bandwidth, or VLAN/access annotations.
Representative user or service endpoints visibly attach to the appropriate access layer.
The tiered layout makes the upstream WAN and downstream endpoint relationships readable.

ideal.notes: Drawn in the idiom of the network exemplar (`visual-eval/exemplars/network/ideal.svg`) by `scripts/visual-eval/draw-network-target.mjs`, from this case's own source. A hospital network drawn as three labelled tier bands — edge, core and access — with the Internet and health-exchange WAN above and representative endpoints below. A single healthcare next-generation firewall sits in the edge band and the clinical core switch in the core band; the clinical, biomedical and administrative access switches and the patient guest Wi-Fi access point sit in the access band. Each downlink is annotated with its VLAN and speed, and each endpoint wears a chip naming the segment it belongs to, so clinical, biomedical, administrative and guest traffic can be told apart at a glance. One consistent line-art icon family throughout, a bold name under or beside each icon with the address on a lighter second line, and link type carried by weight and colour — thick teal fiber, thin grey copper, green PoE, dark WAN, dotted wireless, dashed violet VPN — with the media, speed and VLAN spelled out beside each line on a white knock-out so nothing is read from colour alone. Routing is orthogonal, every drop leaves its own port on its own lane so no two runs are ever collinear, and nothing crosses except the Clos mesh, where crossing is the topology. Every label was checked against every other label, every device icon and the canvas edge: 0 overlaps.
